//: Story Phase 14: Brogath the Bashful, returned inside the Fan Mega-Pack's cardboard cut-out. Printed purple robe, a gold sash he is half hidden behind, a crown, cheeks printed a little pink. Edge-on he is three pixels of corrugated card. Held together by a yellow-green fume.
Brogath, confident (PLEASED): the printed blush gone pale.
Brogath, EMBARRASSED: red-cheeked, a dent in the card from all the fidgeting.
Brogath, PRESSURIZED: the flat card bowing out in the middle.
Brogath, CRITICAL: bowed right out, creased, humming (and shivering in the world).
Brogath in GRAND STENCHMASTER WRATH (the Anger Waft): the print's brows down, red to the edges, the fume gone hot and peppery.
Brogath after the bean breakfast: a cardboard stomach bowing outward where cardboard has no business having a stomach.
Story Phase 14: the captain after Brogath's first eruption took his hat (Jim finds it in a hammock).
Story Phase 14: the Grand Stenchmaster in his regalia, with the Grand Bank's HOLIDAY BRANCH ornament hanging from a point of his Grand Crown. He thinks it completes the look. It does.
